Name: (AT) Emissary's Rugs
Author: EmissaryOfWind
Description:
198 new rugs for Alternative Textures, to decorate your farmhouse in every color! Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].

[b]Version 1.1:[/b] added 101 rugs

[b]Version 1.2:[/b] added 30 rugs

[b]Version 1.3:[/b] added 8 rugs + 27 modular runner rugs

[b]Installation:[/b]
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]- Unzip this mod and drop the contents in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
